title: Bound the deferred chart-127 repair for owned 1540
body:
## Result

Removing the exact #7481 owned role-1540 transfer would save one rank-one paid child per native invocation. Its first mandatory deferred repair is before chart-127 ADD58937. All 1,046 fixed peers and the modified role 756 cannot recover the old role value there. Exact suffix coordinates expose 55 unavailable directions. Two original-input probes kill the peer bank and force incompatible coefficients on the modified role. **NO VERIFIED GAIN.**

The optimistic signed saving is 17 raw before repairs. One extra rank-one child per retained signed call consumes it. Different arrivals, altered old routing and earlier repair are outside the test.

## Replay

From a clean POSIX checkout with CPython 3.12, run `python3.12 -I -B research/p104-owned1540-deferred-cut-bound/replay.py`. It authenticates the exact native word and verified normalized endpoint, computes two sparse suffix pullbacks, and checks both probes through the original and edited prefixes. Both direct bank methods hit their 30-second caps. The exact suffix method finishes within that cap. Direct, registered, source and mode checks, read-only Git-free replay and all 27 onboarding tests passed locally.

## Credit

#7481 supplies the exact native word and complete endpoint certificate, #7480 and #7334 the construction lineage, and #7113 the signed caller. #7491 and #7488 use different fixed-bank cuts. The scientific commit is separate from the two existing #7257 CI prerequisites. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.
